title: Skiouros Pyrophthalmos and the Sciurid Apocalypse A Composite Whiteboard Maria, Artist of Record · 3:60 Room Contributor License Demonstration
creator: Maria (Artist of Record)
description:
A composite classroom-whiteboard artwork by Maria, deposited under a one-time visual-art extension of the 3:60 Room Contributor License. The approximately six-by-three-foot dry-erase composition combines animal figures, institutional annotations, and archive entities, including Gerald the Dolphin and the newly proclaimed Skiouros Pyrophthalmos, the Fire-Eyed Squirrel.

Maria is the sole Artist of Record. Lee Sharks proposed two figures—Skiouros Pyrophthalmos and Gerald the Dolphin—but the body explicitly states that ideation is not authorship. The deposit records Maria’s consent, preserves her authorship in her own name rather than as a heteronym, and demonstrates how the contributor license can receive visual work without absorbing it into the archive’s operator identities.
